title: UN High Seas Treaty's Impact on Singapore's Plans on Maritime Conservation and Building of Flood-mitigation Polders
what_it_is: UN High Seas Treaty's Impact on Singapore's Plans on Maritime Conservation and Building of Flood-mitigation Polders

sections.label: Singapore signing BBNJ treaty
sections.summary: Singapore will sign the treaty on 20 September 2023 and intends to ratify it soon, reflecting its ocean conservation commitment.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Foreign Affairs (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Foreign Affairs)
sentences.text: As Minister Vivian Balakrishnan mentioned in his statement at the UN following the adoption of the treaty, Singapore will sign the Agreement when it opens for signature on 20 September 2023, and we intend to ratify it as soon as possible.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Foreign Affairs (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Foreign Affairs)
sentences.text: This, along with our deep involvement in the BBNJ process, reflects Singapore's commitment to conserve and sustainably use the oceans and their biodiversity.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Foreign Affairs (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Foreign Affairs)
sentences.text: While the treaty will not directly affect marine conservation efforts within Singapore's jurisdiction, it will allow us to play a more active role in global efforts to protect the marine environment in areas beyond national jurisdiction.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Foreign Affairs (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Foreign Affairs)
sentences.text: For example, the treaty provides for a more equitable sharing of the benefits arising from marine scientific research in these areas.

sections.label: Capacity building and territorial waters
sections.summary: Singapore will support capacity building for developing countries, and the treaty has no bearing on its territorial waters measures.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Foreign Affairs (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Foreign Affairs)
sentences.text: Singapore will also support capacity building measures for developing countries to effectively implement the treaty, by sharing our experiences through platforms, such as the Singapore Cooperation Programme.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Foreign Affairs (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Foreign Affairs)
sentences.text: As the treaty concerns areas beyond national jurisdiction, it will have no bearing on Singapore's measures to mitigate sea-level rise, use of polders and our plans for the Greater Southern Waterfront Gateway development, which are well within Singapore's territorial waters.
